title: Puharich's legal pad: ELF emitter in his television

tellings.quote: installed this ELF uh emitter in his television set so when he would turn on the TV, he would get hit by this

plain: In 1994 or 1995, someone put a device that gave off ELF, or extremely low frequency, radio waves inside the television of the scientist Andrija Puharich, so that "when he would turn on the TV, he would get hit by this." An unnamed researcher on the episode tells it from Puharich's own handwritten notes on a legal pad. If true, it would mean Puharich was being secretly targeted in his own home.
